title: Live agent roster
responsibility: Refresh the selected project agent roster and derive freshness-aware sessions and module assignments.

inputs.name: createAgentRosterStore.workspace
inputs.description: Selected project identity and optional bridge.agentActivity({projectId}): Promise<Sample>. Sample is Pick<LiveActivity, 'sampledAt' | 'agents'> and agents.roster contains agent entries with unit IDs. Responses from earlier project selections are discarded.

outputs.name: createAgentRosterStore
outputs.description: loading and error; getters sample: Sample | null, working: number | null, sessions: {agent: AgentEntry, label: string}[], modules: {id: string, owners: AgentEntry[]}[]; refresh(): Promise<void> and listen(): cleanup. A prior project's sample is hidden.

errors.name: activity unavailable
errors.description: Missing bridge reports unavailable. A refresh failure retains any prior scoped sample with an explicit stale-reading message.
